About the role

GREEN INNOVATION SYSTEMS is looking for a motivated Junior Software Engineer to join our Sydney team. This role is ideal for a recent graduate or early-career developer who has strong programming fundamentals, enjoys solving practical problems and wants to grow in a professional software development environment. You will work alongside experienced engineers and other team members to develop, test and maintain software applications. You will contribute to real projects, participate in code reviews and receive support as you build your technical and professional skills. We are not expecting you to know everything from day one. We are looking for someone who is curious, reliable and willing to learn.

Key responsibilities

Develop and maintain reliable, readable and well-tested software

Build and improve application features based on business and user requirements

Work with front-end interfaces, back-end services, APIs and databases

Assist with debugging, troubleshooting and resolving technical issues

Write unit tests and support quality-assurance activities

Participate in code reviews and apply feedback from senior engineers

Collaborate with developers, designers, product team members and other stakeholders

Contribute to technical documentation and internal knowledge sharing

Use Git and established development workflows to manage code changes




About you

You may be a recent graduate, completing your final year of study or already gaining your first professional software-development experience.

To be successful in this role, you should have:

A degree or relevant qualification in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology or a related field

A good understanding of programming fundamentals, data structures and object-oriented development

Experience with at least one programming language such as JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Java or C#

An understanding of web applications, REST APIs and relational databases

Familiarity with SQL and basic database design

Experience using Git or another version-control system

The ability to investigate problems and communicate your approach clearly

Strong attention to detail and a willingness to ask questions

Good written and verbal communication skills

The ability to work independently and collaborate effectively within a team

University projects, personal projects, internships, bootcamp projects and open-source contributions will all be considered relevant experience.




Employer questions
Your application will include the following questions:
Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
What's your expected annual base salary?
How many years' experience do you have as a software engineer?
How much notice are you required to give your current employer?
